column1: # Test-bench matrix cells. One line per "network x entry point x profile".
# TAB-separated. Lines starting with # and blank lines are ignored.
#   network       label for the client network (wired ISP, mobile op, ...)
#   entry         entry-point IP the client dials
#   domain        cover-site domain for this entry (one domain per profile)
#   profile       path to the wire profile .toml the client loads
#   token         client auth token the node accepts
#   control_path  path to a file on the cover site for the control download
